finding: A reserve withdrawal did not reset training idle time. Preparation could consume part of the idle window before the partner joined the team.
implementation: Reset idle time once when the first trustworthy trainee snapshot establishes initial_experience. Preserve this marker through saves and retain the overall expedition deadline.

limitations: Neither Red replay caught a new species. Both retained 111 entries and gained six levels.
The candidate recorded six trainer victories, including a League rematch, and two item pickups. The baseline evolved Gloom.
Local policy recoveries remain frequent, 33 with the candidate and 38 with the baseline. These replays disable save rewinds.
The initially selected Butterfree still failed to gain experience. Travel, supply interruptions, and target selection need further work.
This is a bounded copied-save comparison, not evidence of multi-day reliability.
